data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word ‘esheq’ meaning ‘love’ or ‘passion’. It is a powerful expression of deep emotion and devotion. The name Eshaq carries the meaning “Love, Passion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Eshaq usually hope their child will grow to embody love, passion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
